summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust (AHT) via its subsidiary HH Chicago LLC completed the sale of the Silversmith Hotel Chicago Downtown to SHH Chicago LLC for $16M cash (approx. $15.9M net of expenses). The registrant acted as seller. Concurrently, AHT paid ~$15M to the mortgage lender on a loan secured by 18 hotels including this property. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor disclosed. Pro forma financials filed as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is a Form 8-K under Item 2.01 reporting the completed disposition. Watch for ongoing hotel portfolio rationalization and deleveraging; risk-arb focusing on execution of remaining asset sales and debt reduction.
